subject: Small update to poppr (version 1.1.3) and News

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Small update to poppr (version 1.1.3) and News
parts:
Hello everyone,

Poppr has been updated

This is a small announcement that poppr has been updated and is on CRAN now. Updates for mac and windows should be up within the next couple of days. Version 1.1.3 mainly contains minor improvements and bug fixes. Details can be found here:

version 1.1.3 release notes

One thing I would like to point out is the improved flexibility of the function plot_poppr_msn. It now allows you to adjust the size of the nodes and choose what MLGs are labeled. 


Feature requests

Thibaut Jombart, author of the R package adegenet has recently announced a call for feature requests in this email to the adegenet mailing list due to the upcoming Population Genetics Hackathon at NESCent. If you have any feature requests for the adegenet package, follow the link in the email. If you have any feature requests for poppr specifically, you can make them on github: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/issues (you will need a github account). 

Cheers,
Zhian

Additionally, if you would like to submit anonymous feature requests or bug reports, go here: https://gitreports.com/issue/grunwaldlab/poppr

Cheers,
